sections.html:
Bentonville is the seat of Benton County in the northwest corner of Arkansas, with Rogers to the east, Bella Vista to the north and Centerton to the west. The city counted 19,730 people in 2000, 35,301 in 2010 and 54,164 in 2020, and the 2025 estimate is 63,057. In 2020 it had 22,436 housing units, with 8.7 percent vacant.

Walmart is the largest employer, and its Home Office campus runs along Walton Boulevard (US 71B) on the west side. A consolidated headquarters on about 350 acres was announced in 2017, and the first part opened in January 2025. Over 1,100 vendors keep sales offices in the region. For a seller, a job tied to one of these employers can mean a firm move date, and a seller on a company schedule may not want to wait through a long listing period.

Bentonville Public Schools serve most of the city, with Bentonville High School and Bentonville West High School, the latter located in Centerton. Small eastern portions of the city are zoned to Rogers Public Schools. Families also look at Haas Hall Academy and Founders Classical Academy, which are public charter schools, and at the independent Thaden School. Zoning can differ from one street to the next, so check the district for your address before you describe the house.

sections.h2: Weather, ground and what inspectors check
sections.html:
Bentonville has four seasons. July averages a high of 89 degrees and a low of 66, while January averages a high of 46 and a low of 24. Snowfall averages 9.5 inches a year and total precipitation is about 47 inches. Winter cold matters for heating and pipes.

The county sits on the Springfield Plateau, a karst area with springs, sinkholes and caves, so drainage and ground conditions deserve a look.

  • Roof age and storm damage.
  • Foundation movement and drainage on sloped lots.
  • Furnace and heat pump condition after cold stretches.
  • Sinkhole or ground-settlement signs on karst terrain.

Benton County's collector opens the tax books on the first business day of March, and a 10 percent penalty applies to unpaid amounts after October 15. Taxes are paid one year behind, so a 2026 assessment is billed in 2027 and due October 15, 2027. Tax statements must be mailed by July 1.

sections.h2: How a sale changes the assessment
sections.html:
When real property sells, it is assessed at 20 percent of appraised value at the next assessment date after title transfers. A new owner cannot claim an assessed-value limitation until the second assessment date after the transfer. The county's next countywide reappraisal is listed as 2028.

The homestead credit is up to $600 for a primary residence, and the assessor's homestead department is at 479-271-1037. Tax bills go to the owner of record on January 1 of the tax year, and the closing documents explain how buyer and seller split the bill.

Card payments to the collector carry a convenience fee set by a service provider, with a $3.99 minimum for payments under $110 and 3.59 percent above that. Arkansas also levies a transfer tax of $3.30 per $1,000 of consideration on transfers over $100.

Building permits come from the Building and Fire Safety Division of the Fire Department, at 305 SW A Street. It issues building, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, moving, demolition, sign, pool, fire alarm, fire sprinkler and fence permits, and certificates of occupancy once final inspection passes. The office is reachable at 479-271-3108 or buildingpermits@bentonville.ar.gov, weekdays 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. It also inspects substandard buildings.

If you have unpermitted work or an older structure with open questions, ask the division what is on record before you list. The city has more than 30 properties on the National Register of Historic Places, including two historic districts, so owners of older houses near the square should check whether theirs sits inside one. It can change what repairs and exterior changes are practical for a buyer.

Interstate 49, which carries US 71, is the main route through Bentonville. The Bella Vista Bypass to the north opened in late 2021. Northwest Arkansas National Airport is about 12 miles southwest and opened in 1998. The city has more than 50 miles of trails, and a buyer can tell quickly how close your house is to one.

Many sellers here are balancing a job move, an inheritance, a rental that did not work out, or a house that needs work. A listing still involves repairs, showings and a lender's appraisal.

A cash purchase offers a different route: a single buyer, no financing contingency and a closing date you can pick. Compare it with a listing, including what you would net after repairs and carrying costs. Ask for any offer in writing before you decide.

Once you accept an offer, the title company opens a file and searches the Benton County record for unpaid tax, liens and recorded problems. Have the last tax statement, the deed and permit paperwork ready. If you owned the house through a reappraisal, keep the notice, since the new owner's assessment starts after title transfers.

At closing you sign the deed and the balance owed is paid from your proceeds. Ask who pays recording and transfer tax costs and put the answer in the contract.

faqs.q: Is Bentonville the county seat of Benton County?
faqs.a: Yes. The 19th Judicial Circuit Court sits in the Benton County Courthouse, and deeds for Bentonville houses are recorded in the county.

faqs.q: When are Benton County property taxes due?
faqs.a: October 15, with a 10 percent penalty after that date. The collector opens the books on the first business day of March, and taxes are billed one year behind the assessment year.

faqs.q: How does a sale change my property tax assessment in Bentonville?
faqs.a: The assessor reappraises the house at 20 percent of appraised value at the next assessment date after title transfers. The new owner cannot claim an assessed-value limitation until the second assessment date after the transfer.

faqs.q: Do I need a certificate of occupancy to sell?
faqs.a: The Building and Fire Safety Division issues certificates of occupancy after construction is complete and final inspection is passed. Call 479-271-3108 if you are unsure about work done on your house.

faqs.q: Which district is my Bentonville house in?
faqs.a: Most of the city is in Bentonville Public Schools, and small eastern areas are zoned to Rogers Public Schools. Confirm the district for your address.
